study: Fixed random complete-student subset: certified bridge-quarantine repair
dataset: 1000 students sampled without replacement from all 28785 OULAD students, using NumPy default_rng(314159). Retain every original enrolment for selected students; all four final_result strata; do not select by solver outcomes, repeated-enrolment status or course. Source CSV and original row IDs retained.
motivation: A deployment policy requiring both students and module-presentations to be disjoint across retained partitions. This is stronger than ordinary student-only generalization and is evaluated as a policy stress test, not an inferred leakage definition.
scenarios: Same two seeds and all20 ordered test/validation offering-fold pairs each, 40 total. Test rows locked, remaining rows eligible for train/validation/quarantine. All other targets and budgets unchanged from full-cohort diagnostic.
objective: retained_rows_moved + 10 * newly_quarantined_rows; changed_rows includes both, reported separately
comparison: Validity/status out of all40. Objective/movement reduction only for paired valid cases where SplitMend status is optimal and its lower bound equals objective. Report all feasible-unproven, infeasible, unknown or interrupted outcomes separately; no percentage benefit attributed to optimality when uncertified.
interpretation: Exploratory new task; no percentage target selected or guaranteed, no replacement of prior results, no automatic repository changes. Greedy algorithms are new multi-group/quarantine extensions, not unchanged single-group adapters.
runtime: Total preprocessing plus execution recorded; solver/search budget reported separately. Concurrent jobs share a host, so wall time is descriptive only.
singleton_preprocessing: Count usage across the full selected cohort, remove exactly group tokens with usage1 before passing samples to the solver. This is redundant with the unmodified v0.1.1 solver active-group filtering; equivalence checked explicitly.
